units.name: Normal plasma cell development
units.assessment: Can you trace a plasma cell from the germinal centre reaction through class-switch recombination to the marrow niche, and name the survival signals - IL-6, APRIL, BCMA - that a malignant clone hijacks?

lesson.note: Searched for normal plasma cell ontogeny: the germinal centre reaction, class-switch recombination, the long-lived plasma cell niche and BCMA/APRIL survival signalling. The pool returned only myeloma overviews, a survival-statistics clip and a general leukocyte lecture. Nothing teaches normal B-cell-to-plasma-cell development, which is what this section is about, so the slot is left open.
